inputs.variance_source: R3-02-p4 ANALYSIS.json timing.a/b (5 launches per arm); step time basis = b_selected arm

decision.8GiB: FIXED N = 9 ABBA blocks (36 launches) by the frozen precision gate
decision.4GiB: N_req = 215 > cap 10: UNDERPOWERED for an EXPLAINED verdict; capped experiment NOT to be run; no 4 GiB end-to-end acquisition under this protocol

power_note: The gate is a precision gate at rho=1 (CI half-width <= 0.5), not a power guarantee: at N=9 the approximate probability of an EXPLAINED verdict is ~53% if true rho=1 and ~80% if true rho=1.25; at the cap N=20 it would be ~93% at rho=1. N=9 is the rule's minimum; raising N toward the cap would require an explicit, separately justified addendum decision by the researcher.
